title: PhoenixMessage
description: Wire frame of the Phoenix Channels V2 JSON serializer, used by the mock traffic generator now and by the Phoenix backend later (CLAUDE.md rule 5). Socket URL: /socket/websocket?vsn=2.0.0. Frame: [join_ref, ref, topic, event, payload]. Server pushes have ref = null.

prefixItems.description: join_ref: ref of the phx_join that opened the channel
ref: request ref for replies, null for server pushes
event name, e.g. summary, phx_join, phx_reply, heartbeat
payload; for server pushes, one of the event schemas in this folder
